title: Feature flag filters: v1/v2 config format detection and handling of non-v1 documents
answers: How do flag jobs handle v2 or unsupported filters?
What does filters.version mean vs FeatureFlag.version?
body:
- `filters.version` selects config format; `FeatureFlag.version` is an unrelated concurrency/SDK-invalidation counter (`flag_version_sync.py`).
- `facade/config.py:detect_config_format` returns kind `v1|v2|unsupported`. Absent version or number ==1 -> v1; ==2 -> v2; strings/bools/other numbers -> unsupported. None/{} -> v1. Unsupported is never read as v1.
- Check format BEFORE reading any v1 key (`groups`, `multivariate`, `payloads`). v1-only readers: `facade/references.py:flag_dependency_properties`, `facade/rules.py`, `legacy_definitions.py:validate_legacy_filters`, `dependency_formats.py:require_v1_config`, `flags_cache.py:_stored_dependency_ids`.
- Readers raise `ConfigFormatError`; cache builders omit the row instead: `flags_cache.py:_omit_unsupported_flags` drops the row and transitively its dependents; `local_evaluation.py` skips them; `legacy_definitions.py:drop_legacy_dependents`.
- `_stored_dependency_ids` rejects non-v1 rows regardless of active/deleted, so an inactive v2 row is never blanked into a v1 entry.
- Malformed v1 differs: ConfigFormatError = skip quietly; TypeError/ValueError in `legacy_definitions.py:_is_supported_legacy_flag` = warn, bump FLAG_PROCESSING_ERROR_COUNTER, omit row without failing the team.
- `dependency_formats.py:_dependency_ids` deliberately skips malformed groups; don't merge validation policies.
applies: Code reading flag.filters; new readers must guard with detect_config_format.
says: Feature flag configuration filters version field determines how rules are parsed
Some flag readers cannot handle v2 format filters or unsupported versions
Flag cache detects and omits flags with v2 configuration from SDK responses
How to tell if a feature flag uses v1 or v2 filter configuration format
Non-v1 flag configurations raise errors when v1 specific readers attempt to parse them
search: Feature flag config format is determined by detect_config_format (products/feature_flags/backend/facade/config.py), which returns v1, v2, or unsupported based on the filters.version field: absent/null/{}/version==1 means v1, version==2 means v2, and strings/bools/other numbers mean unsupported (which is never treated as v1). Check format before reading any v1-specific keys (groups, multivariate, payloads); v1-only readers in legacy_definitions.py, dependency_formats.py, and flags_cache.py:_stored_dependency_ids must guard with detect_config_format. Readers raise ConfigFormatError for unsupported formats, but cache builders omit the row instead via _omit_unsupported_flags and drop transitive dependents. Non-v1 rows are rejected regardless of active/deleted status, so inactive v2 rows are never blanked into v1 entries. Malformed v1 differs from unsupported: ConfigFormatError skips quietly, but TypeError/ValueError in legacy_definitions.py:_is_supported_legacy_flag warns and increments FLAG_PROCESSING_ERROR_COUNTER without failing the team. Applies to any new code reading flag.filters.
